name: Death Valley National Park
summary: The hottest, driest, lowest place in North America — a surreal, beautiful desert of salt flats, dunes, and painted hills. Best in spring.

lodging.name: The Ranch or Inn at Death Valley

foodMustTry.name: A cold drink at Furnace Creek

days.summary: Salt flats, dunes, and painted hills.

item.title: Badwater Basin, Zabriskie & Artist's Palette
item.blurb: Stand 282 ft below sea level on the salt flats, catch sunrise at Zabriskie Point, drive Artist's Palette, and see the Mesquite Dunes — go early, it gets brutally hot.
